 Detroit News Powerball numbers for Monday's drawing
 The Detroit News Updated Tue, November 3, 2026 at 4:01 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Powerball numbers for Monday's drawing The winning Powerball numbers in the Monday, Nov. 2, drawing for the $803.9 million jackpot are 07, 29, 64, 23, 66 and the Powerball is 23.
 The cash value is $339.9 million.
 Numbers are drawn at 10:59 p.m. Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. The next drawing is Wednesday.
 Powerball tickets are $2 per play, and in Michigan, players can buy tickets up to 9:45 p.m. for the night of the drawing.
